headword: バイキング{形式|けいしき}

definitions.explanation: A serving format in which diners help themselves freely from a spread of dishes, often for a fixed price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧バイキング{形式|けいしき}だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧バイキング{形式|けいしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: This hotel's buffet-style dinner is popular.

examples.japanese: ⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧バイキング{形式|けいしき}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧なもの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: The party is buffet style, so you can freely take whatever you like.

notes:
The word ⟦バイキング→バイキング：21783_baikingu⟧ (from English "Viking") is the standard Japanese term for an all-you-can-eat buffet; ⟦{形式|けいしき}→形式：00211_keishiki⟧ means "format" or "style." The name originated at a 1950s Tokyo hotel and is not used this way in English.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- バイキング{形式|けいしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧: buffet-style breakfast
- ⟦{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}→食べ放題：08291_tabehoudai⟧: all-you-can-eat (near synonym, stresses unlimited quantity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ビュッフェ→ビュッフェ：11156_byuffe⟧: buffet — a newer loanword from French, common in upscale or hotel settings
